'''MGAD-47''' was an [[AD-series weapons maintenance droid]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. MGAD-37 was assigned to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Mantan Wanderer]]'', overseeing the [[Armory/Legends|armory]] in [[Section Desh-32]], which stored weaponry for [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Task force/Legends|taskforce]] [[Team 19]].<ref name="ROE" />
